title: Beyond SMP - Enhanced
description: The official enhanced modpack for the Beyond SMP. Includes all required mods, shaders, Distant Horizons and optional visual enhancements for the best experience on mid-range and high-end PCs.
body:
# Beyond SMP – Enhanced

Welcome to the official Beyond SMP – Enhanced modpack!

Beyond SMP is a Minecraft Java server inspired by Attack on Titan and Avatar: The Last Airbender, featuring Titan powers, elemental bending, factions, exploration and community events.

The Enhanced edition provides the complete Beyond SMP experience by combining every required server mod with additional visual enhancements and quality-of-life features for players who have a more powerful PC.

## Features ##

* ⚔️ Attack on Titan gameplay through Danny’s AOT Mod.
* 🌊 Avatar-inspired elemental bending.
* 🌄 Multiple shader packs.
* 🏞️ Distant Horizons support.
* ✨ Additional visual enhancements.
* 🧭 Extra client-side quality-of-life mods.
* 🎮 Fabric 1.21.1 support.
* 🛡️ Officially maintained by the Beyond SMP developers.
* 🔄 Updated alongside every server update.

## Why download? ##

This modpack allows you to experience Beyond SMP exactly as intended without manually installing every required mod yourself. It also includes carefully selected client-side enhancements that improve immersion while remaining fully compatible with the server.

## Essential Edition ##

If you have a lower-end PC or simply prefer maximum frame rates, check out Beyond SMP – Essential, which contains all required server mods while remaining lightweight and performance-friendly.

### Credits ###

A huge thank you to danny7_7 for creating Danny’s AOT Mod, which makes the Attack on Titan gameplay in the Beyond SMP possible.

Thanks to all of the amazing mod developers whose work is included in this modpack.
